title: PROPOSED ReceiptOS XRPL anchor commitment descriptor; not XRPL transaction schema
description: Documentation-only proposed profile. Import the frozen product claim-surface schema. Validation proves shape only, never hashes, signature authorization, ledger inclusion, canonical-byte equality or semantic truth. Examples validate their anchor member against this schema.
$comment: MemoData must decode to receipt_root[32] || claim_digest[32]. C = SHA256(ASCII(receiptos.xrpl-receipt-anchor-v0.claim) || 0x00 || UTF8(JCS(claim_preimage))). Schema cannot enforce these relations. Root profile v1 and generic verification v2 are distinct. For the pinned native root, verify its known 0x-prefixed 64 hex representation, then decode the 32-byte digest to normalized lowercase descriptor hex. Check duplicate keys before JSON parsing; use existing closed claim-surface admission and safe-integer limits. Check checkpoint index <= anchor ledger index and same validated history under independently accepted chain trust. Check submitting Account against caller policy, separately from receipt authority. V0 carrier: standalone AccountSet with ordinary Sequence >0, no Ticket, no account-setting fields, no Delegate/Sponsor/batch context. Anchor metadata is external to R, which excludes top-level anchor in the pinned Crystal profile.
